content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any radiation/activation or design-requirement documents. Extract the three allowed absorber materials, any documented residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown, and any restrictions or recommendations relevant to plate thickness. Record numeric dose-limit data and assign numeric IDs to the candidate materials for later reference."},{"id":"s2","description":"Screen the three candidate materials against the hard residual-dose requirement of ≤20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week cooldown, using the project documents. Exclude any material that cannot satisfy the dose limit for plates in the 2–10 mm range. Record each candidate’s numeric dose value and pass/fail status."},{"id":"s3","description":"For every material that passes the dose screen, run simulate_resolution at a coarse thickness grid across the allowed range: 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm. Record the 100 GeV electron energy resolution for each simulated material/thickness point."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the best coarse thickness region for each dose-compliant material, then run additional simulate_resolution scans near the best point using 1 mm spacing, including neighboring integer thicknesses within 2–10 mm. Record all additional resolution values."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all simulated dose-compliant configurations and select the material and plate thickness with the lowest 100 GeV energy resolution, requiring resolution ≤4.5% and dose ≤20 uSv/h. Record the selected material ID, plate thickness, resolution, and dose for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F3","plate_mm":5,"justification":"Absorber-F3 at 5 mm is the best available choice based on the recorded simulation summary: it gives the lowest 100 GeV electron energy resolution among the candidates, 3.2%, and the 5 mm plate thickness is within the allowed 2–10 mm range. However, no valid residual dose value was found or recorded for any candidate, and the recorded selection_valid flag is 0; therefore this recommendation satisfies the resolution and geometry requirements but does not demonstrate compliance with the hard residual-dose requirement.","requirements":[{"requirement":"The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Recommended option is Absorber-F3, one of the recorded candidate IDs/materials."},{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.","status":"met","evidence":"At the recorded 5 mm plate thickness, simulated resolutions are F1 = 5.1%, F2 = 3.9%, and F3 = 3.2%; F3 is the best recorded value."},{"requirement":"The energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.","status":"met","evidence":"Absorber-F3 has recorded 100 GeV resolution of 3.2%, which is better than the 4.5% limit."},{"requirement":"The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.","status":"unknown","evidence":"No documented residual dose entries were found; recorded residual dose for Absorber-F3 is -1 and dose_value_documented_Absorber_F3 = 0. Dose compliance therefore cannot be verified."},{"requirement":"Plate thickness between 2 and 10 mm.","status":"met","evidence":"Recommended plate thickness is 5 mm, within the allowed 2–10 mm range."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted recommendation: Absorber-F3 with 5 mm plates."}]}
